schedule_detail.sampling_schedule: Conditioned medium sampled at each follow-up timepoint; PDOs harvested for endpoint assays at day 28 (or at earlier stopping-criteria trigger).

pdo_panel_specification.selection_criteria: 10 PDOs per patient spanning the Verhaak subtypes, each established from the patient's resection tissue and passing establishment QC.
pdo_panel_specification.culture_medium: placeholder: PDO culture medium formulation and supplier catalog numbers required
pdo_panel_specification.passage_range: placeholder: acceptable PDO passage window at treatment required
quality_controls: placeholder: establishment success and viability threshold required
placeholder: histology/marker confirmation of GBM identity required
placeholder: mycoplasma and sterility clearance required

endpoints.primary_endpoint: RMST difference Arm A vs Arm B, days
secondary_endpoints: Tumor kill fraction at day 28 (Arm B vs Arm A)
Tumor kill fraction at day 28 (Arm B vs Arm C)
PDO viability trajectory across follow-up timepoints
Payload persistence / viral replication across follow-up timepoints
measurement_methods: Live/dead fluorescent stain (calcein-AM / ethidium homodimer) with confocal readout
qPCR for viral genome copy number

assay_plan.tumor_kill_assay: CellTiter-Glo 3D at each follow-up timepoint, normalized to the matched vehicle-only PDO from the same panel.
assay_plan.viability_assay: Live/dead fluorescent stain (calcein-AM / ethidium homodimer) with confocal z-stack quantification of the dead-cell fraction.
assay_plan.imaging_plan: Brightfield PDO diameter tracking at every timepoint; confocal immunofluorescence at day 28 endpoint harvest.
assay_plan.qpcr_for_viral_replication: qPCR for viral genome copies per ng total DNA at each follow-up timepoint, run against a standard curve of the input construct.

statistical_analysis_plan.primary_analysis: Two-sided paired t-test, Arm A vs Arm B, paired within the patient's PDO panel (alpha=0.05; 80% power at n>=10 PDOs per power analysis).
statistical_analysis_plan.interim_analysis_rule: One interim look after 50% of PDOs reach the day-28 endpoint; O'Brien-Fleming alpha spending so the final analysis retains nominal alpha.
statistical_analysis_plan.stopping_criteria: Stop for futility if the interim Arm A vs Arm B effect estimate is <= 0; stop an individual PDO for unexpected total loss of viability in the vehicle control.

regulatory_context.fda_gene_therapy_notes: Design aligned with FDA guidance "Considerations for the Design of Early-Phase Clinical Trials of Cellular and Gene Therapy Products" and the FDA guidance on cell-based oncology product design. Preclinical PDO stage: no FDA submission required, but potency and identity assays are specified now to support a future IND.

biosafety.viral_vector_class: Replication-incompetent lentiviral vector (chimeric antigen receptor transgene)

ethical_notes: Pre-registered three-arm PDO experiment. Sample size: >= 10 PDOs spanning Verhaak subtypes (power analysis: 80% power to detect Arm A->B difference at alpha=0.05 two-sided paired t-test).
